name: Haryana Financial Corporation Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1951, Haryana Financial Corporation Ltd was in the business of 
loan sanctioning[1]
keyPoints:
Operational Status:[1][2]
The Company ceased loan sanctioning in May 2010 and has no outstanding borrowings, having repaid all loans. With no market or bank borrowings during the year, it used limited resources to meet liabilities. As of FY23, it still has Rs. 52 lakh in dues to recover from creditors.

cons: Stock is trading at 8.24 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -32.2% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.18% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 17,035 days to 41,853 days
